design.mood: Ethereal, high-end, and cosmic, blending futuristic aerospace innovation with a dreamy, organic luxury aesthetic.
design.layout: Centered vertical stack with a floating navigation capsule at the top. The typography is layered over a large fluid centerpiece, followed by a secondary row of semi-transparent data cards and a bottom-aligned logo marquee.

typography.mono: JetBrains Mono, regular (used for metadata and small tags)
typography.display: PP Editorial New, serif italic light
typography.body: Inter, sans-serif regular with wide tracking

guardrails: Avoid solid heavy borders; use thin 1px gradients or glows instead.
Do not use standard sans-serif for numbers; they must be high-contrast serif.
Don't allow the background to be pure black (#000); use a deep charcoal with noise.
Avoid aggressive hover states; transitions should be slow and fluid like liquid.
design.centerpiece: An amorphous, iridescent glass-like sphere or 'bubble' containing a dark nebular interior with golden caustic reflections.
design.motion: Continuous slow rotation and deformation of the central glass sphere. Text elements should use a soft 'blur-in' reveal with a slight Y-axis drift, mimicking the floating nature of space.
